OTA is used if the firmware supports it. Older firmware enters the ROM bootloader over the same USB for a first install without removing the board. Keep the ignition and power on throughout.
Choose the application .bin built for GMLAN-USB

Run the first install? The bootloader, partition table and data are kept; the launcher writes and verifies app0 and app1 to replace the firmware whichever OTA slot is active. Nothing is written until you tap YES.
Update the GMLAN-USB firmware? Nothing is written until you tap YES.
Go back without changing the GMLAN-USB

Current firmware has no OTA receiver

The launcher can enter the ROM bootloader via DTR/RTS and load the .ino.bin without removing the board. It validates the GMLAN-USB, rejects encryption or secure boot, writes both OTA slots and compares their MD5 before rebooting. OTA is used afterwards.
Shows how OTA is enabled without removing the board

Notifies you when new firmware is available for the connected GMLAN-USB.
Downloads, verifies and selects it, then notifies you to install it.
Also installs it over OTA after 30 s parked. A first USB install always asks for confirmation.

Versions are published on GitHub. Each download is checked against its SHA-256 sum and the installed version\'s signature. Android asks you to confirm the install, and the launcher only offers it while parked.

Your car\'s CAN frames: Astra H GTC or an imported one

The profile tells the launcher which CAN frame carries each piece of data from your car. The Opel Astra H GTC profile is used by default; if you have made one for your car, import it and select it here. The format is explained in the project repository, linked below.
A .json file in the CAN_SIGNALS.md format
